mapper.select: SELECT id, title, cover_image AS coverImage, created_at AS createdAt, shoot_date AS shootDate, camera_brand AS cameraBrand, camera_model AS cameraModel, is_film AS isFilm, film_stock AS filmStock, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM album ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC

SELECT id, title, cover_image AS coverImage, created_at AS createdAt, shoot_date AS shootDate, camera_brand AS cameraBrand, camera_model AS cameraModel, is_film AS isFilm, film_stock AS filmStock, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM album WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album (id, title, cover_image, created_at, shoot_date, camera_brand, camera_model, is_film, film_stock) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{coverImage}, NOW(), #{shootDate}, #{cameraBrand}, #{cameraModel}, #{isFilm, jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{filmStock})
mapper.update: UPDATE album SET id = #{newId} WHERE id = #{oldId}
UPDATE album SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
